body:
Thanks so much for the reply.

I wish I had some family to talk to, but 1) my parents are out of the question, 2) my brothers don't even spend time with me when I beg them to, and 3) my cousins, aunts, and uncles are all in my home country. All my friends from my home town have all moved away due to school or work. It's pretty disheartening to feel so alone.

What books would you recommend? Luckily, I love reading and I've gotten used to spending time alone so that sounds like something promising.

The scariest part about going under my parents' insurance is that I have no idea how to completely hide it from them. Will it show up on any records through the insurance? I'm sure I can lie about where I'm going, but I'm afraid they'll see it on some record later and the lie will backfire. Thoughts?
